report.summary: No code changed. Root cause: server.mjs sync() updates services upstream answers for and leaves timed-out ones (search, storage in data/upstream.json) with old states, returning {updated, failed}. public/src/sync.js ignores `failed`, always shows "Last synced at HH:MM" and reloads the panel, so the board mixes old/new states with no indication of staleness. SYN-1 only specifies the all-services-answer case; neither it nor the issue defines behavior for partial upstream failure, so the fix is a product decision.
report.question: When upstream times out for some services during Sync now, what should happen? (1) All-or-nothing: apply no new states, show "Sync failed" naming the timed-out services (no "Last synced at"), user can retry. (2) Partial: apply the states that arrived, mark each failed service in the panel as out of date (e.g. "Not updated – last checked HH:MM"), and replace "Last synced at" with an "incomplete sync" message. (3) Something else, e.g. auto-retry failed services first. I recommend option 2, but which do you want?
